observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -22
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://venice.ai/sign-up",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=60000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(7000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("judul:",pg.title()[:80])
    txt=pg.inner_text("body")[:600].replace("\n"," | ")
    print("teks:",txt)
    # cek field form
    for sel in ["input[type=email]","input[name=email]","input[type=password]","button"]:
        print(sel,"->",pg.locator(sel).count())
    print("iframe:",[f.url[:60] for f in pg.frames if f!=pg.main_frame][:4])
    b.close()
PY
